facts.fact: StackAdapt's DSP platform processes over 2 billion auctions each day, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: the StackAdapt DSP platform processes over 2 billion auctions each day!

facts.fact: Real-time bidding is described by the vendor as a process in which ad inventory is bought and sold as part of an instant auction that happens in less than a second.
facts.quote: It’s a process that happens in less than a second, as part of an instant auction.

facts.fact: The vendor states that RTB auctions sell inventory on a per impression basis.
facts.quote: RTB uses an instant auction to sell inventory, on a per impression basis.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, publishers can set minimum bids and advertisers can set maximum bids as parameters within RTB auctions.
facts.quote: publishers can set minimum bids and advertisers can set their maximum bids.

facts.fact: The vendor describes an RTB bid request as containing user information such as demographic data, location information, and browser history.
facts.quote: This bid request will contain various types of information about the user, like their demographic data, location information, and browser history.
